guard_streams.write_limit: Historic Public Review mapping and procurement steps are subsidy-targeting evidence. They cannot establish current selected-parcel serviceability or measured speed.

facts.detail: The closure page was updated on 23 June 2026.
The Public Reviews concluded on 29 April 2022 at 5pm.
The Public Reviews began on 29 March 2022.
BDUK requested evidence from the public, businesses, ISPs and infrastructure providers.
The release covered six areas: Derbyshire, Lancashire, Beds/Northants/MK, East Sussex, Surrey, and Wiltshire/South Gloucestershire.
The reviews aimed to validate the OMR outcome and BDUK mapping.
The preceding OMR was published on 20 October 2021.
The preceding OMR ended on 22 November 2021.
BDUK planned to finalise intervention areas after evaluating responses.
The next step was formal procurement through an Invitation to Tender.
